text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Mile CS. Formidable rivals 
like Biko Pegasus and Hishi Akebono are 
running today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even the great Fuji Kiseki showed a hint 
of nerves. However, the three of them 
pledged to do their best, and with smiling 
shouts of "Ei-ei-oh!"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's nervousness vanished into 
thin air. Together, they head out to the 
race.
